Package edu.ucsb.cs156.frontiers.services

Class SlackService

java.lang.Object
edu.ucsb.cs156.frontiers.services.SlackService
@Service public class SlackService extends Object
Service for interacting with the Slack Web API.

A Slack bot token (xoxb-...) is already associated with a specific workspace, so the token alone is sufficient to identify where API calls go.

Note that the Slack Web API typically returns HTTP 200 even for failures; the ok field of the response indicates success, and error contains an error code (e.g. invalid_auth, missing_scope).

Tokens are secrets; they must never be logged.

    • setSleeper

    • authTest

      public SlackAuthTestResponse authTest(String token)
      Calls the Slack auth.test method to check whether a bot token is valid.
      Parameters:
      token - the (plaintext) Slack bot token
      Returns:
      the response from Slack; if ok is true, team and teamId identify the workspace the token belongs to. If Slack cannot be reached, a response with ok false and error SLACK_UNREACHABLE is returned.

    • listUsers

      public List<SlackUser> listUsers(String token)
      Calls the Slack users.list method (following pagination) to get all members of the workspace the token belongs to. This includes bots, deactivated accounts, and users who have been invited but have not yet signed in; see SlackUser.isActivePerson().

      Requires the users:read scope; emails are only included if the token also has the users:read.email scope.

      Parameters:
      token - the (plaintext) Slack bot token
      Returns:
      all members of the workspace
      Throws:
      SlackApiException - with the Slack error code (e.g. missing_scope) if Slack reports an error, or SLACK_UNREACHABLE if Slack cannot be reached

    • listPublicChannels

      public List<SlackChannel> listPublicChannels(String token)
      Calls the Slack conversations.list method (following pagination) to get all public channels of the workspace, including archived ones (the name of an archived channel is still taken). Requires the channels:read scope.
      Parameters:
      token - the (plaintext) Slack bot token
      Returns:
      the public channels of the workspace
      Throws:
      SlackApiException - with the Slack error code if the call fails

    • createPublicChannel

      public SlackChannel createPublicChannel(String token, String name)
      Calls the Slack conversations.create method to create a public channel; the bot becomes a member of the channel it creates. Requires the channels:manage scope.
      Parameters:
      token - the (plaintext) Slack bot token
      name - name of the channel (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens and underscores)
      Returns:
      the new channel
      Throws:
      SlackApiException - with the Slack error code (e.g. name_taken, invalid_name_specials) if the call fails

    • joinChannel

      public void joinChannel(String token, String channelId)
      Calls the Slack conversations.join method so that the bot is a member of a public channel, which it has to be to invite or remove members. Joining a channel the bot is already in is not an error. Requires the channels:join scope.
      Parameters:
      token - the (plaintext) Slack bot token
      channelId - id of the channel
      Throws:
      SlackApiException - with the Slack error code if the call fails

    • listChannelMembers

      public List<String> listChannelMembers(String token, String channelId)
      Calls the Slack conversations.members method (following pagination). Requires the channels:read scope.
      Parameters:
      token - the (plaintext) Slack bot token
      channelId - id of the channel
      Returns:
      the Slack user ids of the members of the channel
      Throws:
      SlackApiException - with the Slack error code if the call fails

    • inviteToChannel

      public void inviteToChannel(String token, String channelId, List<String> userIds)
      Calls the Slack conversations.invite method to add users to a channel that the bot is a member of. Slack adds either all of the users or none of them. Requires the channels:manage scope.
      Parameters:
      token - the (plaintext) Slack bot token
      channelId - id of the channel
      userIds - Slack user ids; at most 1000
      Throws:
      SlackApiException - with the Slack error code (e.g. already_in_channel) if the call fails

    • removeFromChannel

      public void removeFromChannel(String token, String channelId, String userId)
      Calls the Slack conversations.kick method to remove a user from a channel that the bot is a member of. Requires the channels:manage scope.
      Parameters:
      token - the (plaintext) Slack bot token
      channelId - id of the channel
      userId - Slack user id
      Throws:
      SlackApiException - with the Slack error code (e.g. restricted_action) if the call fails
